item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:05 HKT 18/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the combined effect of the northeast monsoon and Tropical Cyclone Nesat, it will be windy with a few showers, and temperatures will fall progressively over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. With Nesat departing Guangdong, the weather will improve over the coastal areas in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 18/10 (Tuesday)
Wind: North to northeast force 6, force 7 offshore, occasionally force 8 on high ground.
Weather: Cloudy with showers. Temperatures will fall appreciably. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 19 - 27 C
R.H. range: 40 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High

Date/Month: 19/10 (Wednesday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers.
